definitions.explanation: A substance that gives color to something, whether natural (such as melanin in skin) or artificial (such as food coloring).

examples.japanese: {色素|しきそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧。
⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{色素|しきそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈着|ちんちゃく}→沈着：09171_chinchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Exposure to UV rays causes pigmentation.

notes:
A compound of {色|しき} (color) and {素|そ} (element, substance). Used broadly in biology, medicine, food science, and cosmetics to refer to any substance responsible for color.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色素|しきそ}⟦{沈着|ちんちゃく}→沈着：09171_chinchaku⟧ — pigmentation (deposit of pigment in skin)
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{色素|しきそ} — artificial coloring
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{色素|しきそ} — natural pigment
- {色素|しきそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ — to have light pigmentation
- メラニン{色素|しきそ} — melanin pigment
